Fashion-MNIST: a Novel Image Dataset for Benchmarking Machine Learning Algorithms

Han Xiao Affiliation: Zalando Research Affiliation: Mühlenstraße 25, 10243 Berlin Email: author@example.org    Kashif Rasul Affiliation: Zalando Research Affiliation: Mühlenstraße 25, 10243 Berlin Email: author@example.org    Roland Vollgraf Affiliation: Zalando Research Affiliation: Mühlenstraße 25, 10243 Berlin Email: author@example.org
Abstract

We present Fashion-MNIST, a new dataset comprising of 28×2828\times 28 grayscale images of 70,00070,000 fashion products from 1010 categories, with 7,0007,000 images per category. The training set has 60,00060,000 images and the test set has 10,00010,000 images. Fashion-MNIST is intended to serve as a direct drop-in replacement for the original MNIST dataset for benchmarking machine learning algorithms, as it shares the same image size, data format and the structure of training and testing splits. The dataset is freely available at https://github.com/zalandoresearch/fashion-mnist.
